logging/rotation#

Log files that rotate by size or by time, keeping some backups.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let file = RotatingLogFile(path: Path("app.log"), options: options,
    rotation: SizeRotating((10485760)), backups: 5, clock: SystemClock());

Description#

Log files that rotate by size or by time, keeping some backups.
